notes.title: Demo Available Now!
notes.notes: [p][b]Our demo is out TODAY![/b] This first full episode of [i]The Left Eye[/i] lets you meet our rogues' gallery, unlock 10 CGs, browse the in-game codex, and engage in crimes both petty and otherwise. We’ve got lots more planned, but for now, we hope you enjoy episode one![/p][p]If you’ve wishlisted the game already, we can’t thank you enough. We're a tiny team and it means a lot to us, and really helps us out![/p][p]We truly hope you enjoy this slice of 1920s NYC. We’re grateful to share our work with you![/p][p][/p][p]🎺 👻 [i]Haunted Trumpet [/i][/p]

notes.title: Demo Release Date: July 31st
notes.notes: [p]Hello! After a lot of hard work, our demo is finally ready and will be available on [b]July 31st[/b]! It includes the complete first episode of [b]The Left Eye[/b], so you can dip your toe into the pansy scene and see if it's your sort of thing! And if it is, why not wishlist the game to stay notified of upcoming episodes?[/p][p]We're unbelievably excited to start sharing our visual novel with you, and we're grateful to everyone who's shown interest so far. [/p][p]See you in New York![/p][p][/p][p]🎺 👻 [i]Haunted Trumpet [/i][/p]
